## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2014-06-06: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.6 to S-1/A
- 2014-08-01: Spark Energy Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement filed at 85% to the Members of Spark HoldCo (NuDevco Retail Holdings and Maxwell-controlled vehicles), with W. Keith Maxwell III as Agent (8-K)

#### Standalone termination

- 2019-07-11: TRA Termination and Release Agreement executed, terminating the TRA in exchange for an $11,239,250 cash payment to the Members (paid July 15, 2019); approved by a Special Committee with a Stout fairness opinion (8-K Item 1.01)

## Explanation

Via Renewables, Inc. (then Spark Energy, Inc.) executed an 85% Up-C Tax Receivable Agreement at its August 2014 IPO close, paying the Spark HoldCo Members (NuDevco Retail Holdings and other Maxwell-controlled vehicles) 85% of the cash tax savings realized from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of HoldCo Units. After a Special Committee process running since at least 2018 and a Stout Advisory fairness opinion, the parties executed a standalone TRA Termination and Release Agreement on July 11, 2019 that fully terminated the contract for an $11,239,250 cash payment to the Members, with a parallel $16,260,750 Spark HoldCo LLC Agreement Gross Up Payment netted in the same transaction. The TRA never reinstated: the August 2022 rebrand to Via Renewables and the June 2024 take-private merger with Retailco, LLC carry no TRA-related entries (the DEFM14A explicitly notes the TRA was already terminated). See `contract_log.md` for the Termination and Release Agreement text and the post-termination corporate history.
